attributes.name: Shadow Barbs
attributes.powers: For your combat check against a bane, recharge this card to use your Arcane, Divine, or Melee skill + 1d10 and add the Finesse trait. If you would fail this check and are proficient with weapons, you may instead discard this card to ignore the result and evade the bane.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, if you would discard this card for its power, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check to recharge this card instead.
